answer: Since the throttle counters live in the thread ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. An operator running 43 keys thus pays for 43 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the ledge quota and the signal admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 3 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole fleet at once. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
